The vivid markings upon their faces are thought to allow the beasts to identify individuals among the herd.
STR_FF14_CARD_411_DESC: The pride of Alexandria's mechanical army, the sentry unit comes in several variations, including the gun-wielding G-type and the sword-swinging S-type. The R-type is designed to operate military-grade airborne vehicles with deadly efficiency.
STR_FF14_CARD_412_DESC: These general-use machines were developed to supplement the dwindling labor force after Alexandria’s population was left decimated by warfare and calamities. Not only are they adept at everyday chores such as cleaning and maintenance, but they can also offer stiff competition in various card games.
STR_FF14_CARD_414_DESC: This odd specimen of the uolon─a creature closely related to the troll─purposefully swallows slimes to “raise” them in its belly. Although the loss of nutrients results in frequent bouts of drowsiness, it allows the beast to spit up its ingested guests as battle reinforcements should it ever feel threatened.
STR_FF14_CARD_415_DESC: Ryoqor Terteh is often spotted frolicking on the frigid slopes of Worqor Zormor with its lesser kin. In the Yok Huy tongue, its name means “talkative snow spirit from the moon.” True to the description, it seems to delight in inviting travelers to play in its snowy games.
STR_FF14_CARD_416_DESC: Thought to have been created by the Yok Huy for quarrying purposes, Maulskull became a sentry when its operational runes were partially overwritten by persons unknown. With its deadly, hammer-like head, it inflicts punishing blows upon any foolish enough to trespass into the Skydeep Cenote.
STR_FF14_CARD_417_DESC: Origenics researchers sought to create loyal undead minions by infusing corpses with an excess of souls. Test subject Ambrose was disobedient to the last, likely due to the fact that in life he was a member of the resistance organization Oblivion.
STR_FF14_CARD_418_DESC: Having nurtured immense strength over its unnaturally long lifespan, the winged serpent known also as the “Skyruin” ruled uncontested over the lands of Tural for centuries. It was sealed in ice some eight decades earlier by Gulool Ja Ja, only to be freed again during the recent rite of succession.
STR_FF14_CARD_419_DESC: “Let the victor's reign be sanctioned by the blood of the fallen.”
STR_FF14_CARD_420_DESC: Having resolved to plunder aether from other worlds, Sphene shed her conscience by erasing her memories and arose as this entity within the Meso Terminal. It wields the absolute authority of Alexandria's eternal queen, and exists solely to sustain the Endless.
STR_FF14_CARD_421_DESC: Wielding the feral soul of the dread feline Cath Palug, this razor-sharp clawed rookie of the Arcadion tears across the ring─and through her foes─with astonishing agility.
STR_FF14_CARD_422_DESC: “Upon mine honor, you shall harm neither my fair queen nor our citizens!”
STR_FF14_CARD_423_DESC: “Wherever your journeys take you, keep me close to your heart, will you? I should like to be there, to see what I haven't seen.”
STR_FF14_CARD_424_DESC: “I'm going to become Dawnservant─and I will protect my people!”
STR_FF14_CARD_425_DESC: “I am the bearer of the memories of Queen Sphene of Alexandria, and my desire to protect my people transcends all others!”
STR_FF14_CARD_426_DESC: A devotee of Zoraal Ja's expansionist ideals, Kanilokka ran a secret laboratory where he labored with others educated in electrope technology to develop new battlefield advancements. Though he perished ere his research could bear fruit, such was his obsession that his spirit refused to pass on.
STR_FF14_CARD_427_DESC: An echo formed from the memories of Vana'diel's Crystal Warriors. Resembling a Mithra, this entity is said to embody that race's deep-seated envy.
STR_FF14_CARD_428_DESC: An echo formed from the memories of Vana'diel's Crystal Warriors. Resembling a Tarutaru, this entity is said to embody that race's deep-seated cowardice.
STR_FF14_CARD_429_DESC: An echo formed from the memories of Vana'diel's Crystal Warriors. Resembling a Galka, this entity is said to embody that race's deep-seated rage.
STR_FF14_CARD_430_DESC: An echo formed from the memories of Vana'diel's Crystal Warriors. Resembling a Hume, this entity is said to embody that race's deep-seated apathy.
STR_FF14_CARD_431_DESC: An echo formed from the memories of Vana'diel's Crystal Warriors. Resembling an Elvaan, this entity is said to embody that race's deep-seated arrogance.
STR_FF14_CARD_432_DESC: A tural vidraal whispered of in tones of dread, the “Serpentlord” has crushed entire villages beneath its scaled bulk, and even humbled a seasoned viper intent on taking its head. Named in the Hhetsarro tongue, it is the dweller beneath the shifting sands and the swallower of rroneek.
STR_FF14_CARD_433_DESC: This mascot of Living Memory was created for the purpose of bringing smiles as brilliant as the mica for which it was named. Due to a lack of regular maintenance, however, its programmed behavior has become increasingly erratic.
STR_FF14_CARD_434_DESC: This echo was fashioned from the memories of Prishe, a young girl of Vana'diel. Her powers of recollection have been warped that she might better serve her creator's purpose, which in turn has resulted in an appearance not entirely matching that of her original form.
STR_FF14_CARD_435_DESC: This echo was formed from the memories of Vana'diel's tyrannical Shadow Lord. The original was remembered as a terrifying presence who rallied the beastmen against the nations of man in a war of wrath and vengeance.
STR_FF14_CARD_436_DESC: Once deployed in the castle of Alexandria as a defense mechanism, the Valia Pira was reactivated by Calyx to test the capabilities of the Warrior of Light. It executed unpredictable attack patterns by manifesting orbs of aetherial power to energize its roaming sub-units.
STR_FF14_CARD_437_DESC: “Allow me to bid you a warm welcome to the Manderville Gold Saucer. How might I be of service?”
STR_FF14_CARD_438_DESC: Drawing on Sphene's memory data, this mechanical construct was designed to emulate the combat skills of the valiant Zelenia─second-in-command of the royal knights of Alexandria. Zelenia contributed greatly to the defense of the kingdom during the Storm Surge conflict, and was said to display an unrivaled resolve when it came to protecting those under her charge.
STR_FF14_CARD_439_DESC: The Howling Blade is the Arcadion's cruiserweight champion. Long has he defended his title against all comers, combining his spectacular swordplay with a mastery over earth and wind conferred by the soul of Fenrir. Being a “babyface” fighter and a handsome man to boot, he enjoys an overwhelming degree of support from the cheering crowds.
STR_FF14_CARD_440_DESC: This fearsome voidsent encountered at the summit of the Tower of Blood is believed to have been called into the corporeal plane via advanced Mhachi summoning techniques. It appears the architect of the Occult Crescent had forged a covenant with the being, and granted it special weapons with which to defend the tower.
STR_FF14_CARD_441_DESC: A variety of seedkin whose head and body are cloaked in leaves. Those that inhabit Yak T'el have taken on a luminous blue hue owing to the influence of the meteorites scattered throughout the forest. The local Mamool Ja hold the creatures to be their kind who were cursed, and go to great lengths to avoid them lest they be likewise afflicted.
STR_FF14_CARD_442_DESC: A ferocious and powerful scalekin native to Tural. The Mamool Ja have succeeded in their domestication, and employ the creatures as beasts of burden in daily life and living battering rams in war. Those specimens seen in Eorzea in recent years were brought across the seas by Mamool Ja mercenaries.
STR_FF14_CARD_443_DESC: One of the three Mamool Ja clans, the Doppro are identifiable by their distinct speckled scales. Despite being far fewer in number than the Hoobigo and Boonewa, they are by no means considered lesser in status; on the contrary, they are highly regarded for their mastery in the handling of wild beasts such as the wivre.
STR_FF14_CARD_444_DESC: “I am the final hurdle before fledgling players go on to challenge the realm's best Triple Triad tacticians. Overcoming my curated strategies is paramount to their future standing.”
STR_FF14_CARD_445_DESC: Calyx created this amalgamation of memories from the recollections stored in the Meso Terminal. Empowered by electrope devices installed in its chamber, this massive entity was able to manifest shared experiences as physical phenomena, and employ them in devastating attacks.
STR_FF14_CARD_446_DESC: This echo was formed from the memories of Kam'lanaut, Archduke of Jeuno in Vana'diel. Though hailed as a hero by the people, he is, in truth, one of the last survivors of an ancient race known as the Zilart.
STR_FF14_CARD_447_DESC: This echo was formed from the memories of Eald'narche, older brother of Kam'lanaut, who governed Jeuno alongside him in Vana'diel. The eldest prince of the ancient Zilart, he remains undeterred by the passage of ages in his quest to open the Gates of Paradise.
STR_FF14_CARD_448_DESC: This dreadful primal was given form by the collective fear of death experienced by the citizens of Alexandria. The intense terror felt by those suddenly forced to confront the realities of mortal existence─a truth they had long avoided by entrusting their memories of departed loved ones to the cloud─fueled the entity with a dark and inexorable power.
STR_FF14_CARD_449_DESC: Developed to withstand the harsh environs of foreign stars, this mech is powerful enough to destroy crystal and perform other labor-intensive tasks for the Cosmic Exploration Initiative. A number of these units have been simplified and prepared as rewards for contributors.
STR_FF14_CARD_450_DESC: “Yes, it is I, Namingway! I am ever so glad to see you all awake!”
STR_FF14_CARD_451_DESC: Counted among Ryoqor Terteh's lesser kin, Rorrlo Tehs are sometimes sighted cavorting around the icy heights of Worqor Zormor. In the Yok Huy tongue, their name means “little spirit illuminated by moonlight,” but despite the peaceful image this evokes, many an unwary traveler has found themselves frozen─in jest, of course─by the playful pranksters.
STR_FF14_CARD_452_DESC: Encountered along Pilgrim's Traverse in the environs of Il Mheg, this botanical behemoth is thought to be an unfortunate mortal transformed by fae magicks. Whether its extreme belligerence is a vestige of its former self or the result of transfiguration remains unclear.
STR_FF14_CARD_453_DESC: “And from this day forward, the spirits and the Yok Huy shall walk side by side. Dartorgor is proud, I can feel it.”
STR_FF14_CARD_454_DESC: “So please, be at peace. Be at peace, Mother, Father.”
